text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On a day off, Grass Wonder invited me along,
so we visited the "Umamusume History Exhibition."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: So the passion for racing has been passed down like this, huh~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A wide variety of exhibits were on display, ranging from
early racing horseshoes and photos of Umamusume races
to letters written by legendary Umamusume to their Trainers."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Learning from the past to understand the new...
This is truly an invaluable lesson.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Watching them like this,
their burning passion comes through loud and clear.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I have to run properly too, so I don't bring shame to our seniors.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As an Umamusume, she seemed to genuinely appreciate the rich history that had been woven through the ages.

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text: Her face is fine, but her figure, eh... Just lacking, y'know. 57 points!

text_block_list.name: Man B
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't that price high? Plus, you look way too desperate in that race photo.
Hard pass~ 43 points!"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Oh. What a very loud voice.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite the frowns from those around her,
she showed no sign of stopping whatsoever...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...I'll be right back.
choice_data_list: It's dangerous to get caught up in trouble

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu,
thank you for worrying about me.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Still, what I can't give up on, I just can't give up on~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She casually strolled up to the men and gave them a light tap on the shoulder.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: What did you come here to do?

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text: Huh.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
If that's the only metric you can judge them by,
perhaps this place isn't suitable for you?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"You are bothering the other guests who came to enjoy the history.
...Please leave at once."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sensing a fathomless dread
in her calm, detached tone,
the men hastily scrambled away.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...
I went a bit too far with what I said.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Still, I just couldn't let it slide.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From her gentle smile,
I could sense the unyielding conviction hidden beneath her kindness.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Fufu, thank you so much~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Approaching the men,
she called out, "Excuse me for a moment~"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Making loud remarks that put down the exhibits
is bothersome to both the other visitors and the organizers~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I don't believe this is the proper place to discuss such matters,
what do you think~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gracefully rebuked, and perhaps noticing the stares around them,
the men awkwardly took their leave.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...I know that there are all kinds of people out there, but...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: The only thing I can't forgive is desecrating history~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From her gentle smile,
one could feel a profound respect for the generations of Umamusume before her.
